content.text:
Read the decision log first, then did a full line-by-line pass across every file this branch touches (component .tsx, .css.ts, .test.tsx, .stories.tsx, hooks, utils, theme registration, and the three Contentful seed scripts). Findings below map to the four numbered angles in the brief. ## 1. Recipe shape parity (`zimmCountryLanguageMismatch.css.ts` vs `zimmDrawer.css.ts`) **CLEAN.** Same `parts`/`baseStyle` object shape, same media-query technique (`` [`@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})`] ``, both importing `breakpoints` from `app/theme/foundation`), same registration pattern in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (import + bare key, `ZimmDrawer` at line 6/54, `ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch` at line 46/94). The one structural difference — `ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch` has no `variants` key at all — is explicitly justified in the file's own header comment (`zimmCountryLanguageMismatch.css.ts:10-16`, citing decisions.md #5: Figma defines only `Step=–`, no state variants). Not a silent divergence. ## 2. Full-diff DRY/value-duplication hunt (the core of this pass) **`HEADER_PADDING_Y` across small/prompt/xLarge — CONFIRMED CLEAN.** All three variants (`zimmDrawer.css.ts:244-249`, `:296-301`, `:313-318`) emit the byte-identical `{ minHeight: 'unset', paddingBlock: HEADER_PADDING_Y }` inside the same `md+` media block. No divergence. **Token cross-reference claims — CONFIRMED ACCURATE.** `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch.css.ts:30-32`'s claim that `var(--zimm-scale-2xl)`/`var(--zimm-scale-1200)` are already used for the same two pixel values in `zimmDrawer.css.ts`'s `HEADER_PADDING_COMPACT_X` (`:64`) and `INSET_LARGE.top` (`:58`) checks out by direct comparison — not a false citation. Underlying pixel values also verified against foundation (`spacing.ts:16-19`: 2xl=32px/4xl=64px/5xl=80px; `zimmTokens.ts:167`: scale-1200=48px), and each var has 7-15 other real repo-wide consumers — genuinely reused tokens, not invented for this feature. The 32/48px container padding and 64/80px content→button gap also match decisions.md's design-comparison checkpoint values exactly. **Finding A — `zimmDrawer.css.test.ts:112`.** `expect(ZimmDrawer.baseStyle.headerCloseButton.height).toBe('2.75rem'); // DRAWER_HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT` hardcodes the value instead of importing the real constant from `app/theme/components/zimmDrawerShared` — which the file under test (`zimmDrawer.css.ts:2`) already imports, and which *is* exported (unlike `PANEL_MIN_NARROW`/`MOBILE_BOTTOM_GAP`/`HEADER_PADDING_Y`, all correctly hardcoded elsewhere in this same test file because they're module-private). This is the one assertion in the file where an import was actually available and wasn't used. 🔵 low · **CONFIRMED** · **ONE-OFF** — a real drift would fail the test loudly, not silently, so impact is a maintenance nit, not a correctness risk. **Finding B — seed scripts duplicate component copy against a comment-only promise.** `scripts/contentful/seedRegionalPromptUiCopy.mjs:32-105` (8 entries) and `scripts/contentful/seedDrawerCloseUiCopy.mjs:34-45` (1 entry) both hand-type English `value` strings that must stay byte-identical to a different file's fallback text — `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.tsx`'s `VARIATION_CONFIG` (`:93-111`) and `zimmDrawer/index.tsx`'s `t('drawer.close', 'Close')` (`:178`,`:183`) respectively. Both scripts' own doc comments admit this is unenforced (`seedRegionalPromptUiCopy.mjs:17-21`: "A mismatch here doesn't break the build... it just means Contentful's English entry silently diverges"). I hand-verified all 9 strings are currently byte-identical on both sides — no live defect — but this is exactly "a parallel literal that only a comment promises to keep in sync," and unlike Finding A/C, nothing here would fail loudly if it drifts (no test cross-checks a seed script's values against the component). Worth noting the branch *did* eliminate the mechanical/plumbing duplication across these same three scripts (`resolveTarget`/`seedUiCopyEntries` extracted to `scripts/contentful/setup/_shared.mjs`, confirmed via `seedLoginDrawerUiCopy.mjs`'s diff and commit `ba73b20`) — the remaining duplication is specifically the copy *content*, which the cross-runtime boundary (Node seed script vs. React component) makes harder to share via a real import. 🟡 moderate · **CONFIRMED** · **UNIFORM** (recurs in 2 of the 3 touched seed scripts). **Finding D — stale self-referential comment in `zimmDrawer.css.ts:299`.** `prompt.header`'s `paddingBlock: HEADER_PADDING_Y,` carries the trailing comment `// already defined, currently only consumed by xLarge — 24px`. That's now factually wrong within this same file: `small.header` (`:244-249`, added later per decisions.md's A6 pass) also consumes `HEADER_PADDING_Y`, making it three consumers (`small`, `prompt`, `xLarge`), not one. Grepped the surrounding files for the same "only consumed by" phrasing — this is the only occurrence, so it's isolated to this one line, most likely left over from when A5 (`prompt`) was written before A6 (`small`) added a third consumer. 🔵 low (cosmetic, doesn't affect runtime or tests) · **CONFIRMED** · **ONE-OFF**. ## 3. Token semantic-intent check **CLEAN.** Grepped every `var(--zimm-color-*)` in the touched non-recipe component files: exactly two hits, both in `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.tsx` (`:175`, `:178`), both `color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)"` applied to `color:` on `

`/`

` text nodes — category matches property. `zimmDrawer/index.tsx` has zero direct `var(--zimm-color-*)` usages (all styling flows through the recipe via `sx={styles.*}`), so there's nothing to mismatch there. ## 4. Test-file duplication **`zimmLanguagePrompt/index.test.tsx` — CLEAN**, and the good counter-example: it imports the real `EU_LANGUAGE_CONFIG` (`:5`) and the real `SUPPORTED_EU_LANGUAGES` via `importOriginal` (`:43`) rather than hand-typing copies, and even carries its own drift-guard test (`:237-239`) built on those real imports. **Finding C — `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.test.tsx:59-69`.** Hand-types 8 fallback-copy constants (`LOCATION_HEADING_FALLBACK`, `LANGUAGE_BODY_FALLBACK`, etc.) that duplicate `VARIATION_CONFIG`'s fallback strings in `index.tsx:93-111`. This one is structurally forced — `VARIATION_CONFIG` is module-private (no `export` keyword anywhere in the 191-line file), so there's no constant to import even if the test wanted to. The gap is that nothing says so: contrast with `index.stories.tsx:60-64`, which has an explicit comment justifying its own equivalent hand-typing of the language-map's display values ("hand-typed... not re-imported from it... a drift here is a visible story regression, not a silent divergence"). The test file has no equivalent note explaining why it re-types rather than, say, exporting `VARIATION_CONFIG` for reuse. 🔵 low · **CONFIRMED** · **ONE-OFF** — low risk since a drift would fail these specific text-matching assertions loudly, and `VARIATION_CONFIG` is documented as "frozen by SFCC-831's decision record" (`index.tsx:85`), but it's the same un-explained-duplicate shape the task asked to flag, just with no test-breakage downside like Finding B. ## Summary table | # | Location | Severity | Status | Uniform/One-off | |---|---|---|---|---| | A | `zimmDrawer.css.ts` test — hardcoded `'2.75rem'` instead of importing `DRAWER_HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT` | 🔵 | CONFIRMED | ONE-OFF | | B | `seedRegionalPromptUiCopy.mjs` + `seedDrawerCloseUiCopy.mjs` — copy duplicated against component fallbacks, comment-enforced only | 🟡 | CONFIRMED | UNIFORM | | C | `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.test.tsx:59-69` — hand-typed `VARIATION_CONFIG` fallback duplicates, unexplained (vs. story's explicit rationale for its own case) | 🔵 | CONFIRMED | ONE-OFF | | D | `zimmDrawer.css.ts:299` — stale "currently only consumed by xLarge" comment, now wrong (3 consumers) | 🔵 | CONFIRMED | ONE-OFF | No 🔴 findings. Nothing here contradicts a recorded decision in `decisions.md` — all four are new observations at the "does this comment/duplicate still match itself" level that the decision log doesn't address.
